WHY_TEACHER_ANCHORING: TA2 already established that equal-weight ensemble logit distillation plus optional route anchoring improves ranking beyond matched T-OPT initialisation (mean Δ vs C2-OPT = +0.007518; SUPPORTED_STRONG).
WHY_ODST: Under a matched teacher-guided linear control, ODST did not provide a reproducible predictive increment. Route/leaf traceability remains, but the paper cannot claim standalone ODST superiority over the simpler linear head.
